turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale. I know who you are. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
Owen talks about you in class, by the way.
Is that relevant, Hale, or is it a way of not answering me? If Owen said something, tell me exactly what, and when.
He's one of the kindest kids I teach. He walked a new student around the building all through September.
Then why is there a zero in his gradebook? Don't soften me up, Hale. What do you have?
A kid like that doesn't cheat out of malice. He was overwhelmed. We can both agree on that, right?
You said "cheat", and I'm writing that down. I'm agreeing to nothing about Owen, and you're leading me. Where is your evidence?
